svg.title: Progressive oval movement: light to shaded
svg.desc: Three sequential oval drills from C. P. Zaner, Lessons in Ornamental Penmanship, PDF29, printed page27. The source row is rearranged vertically for phone readability; the original curves and swells are retained.
